What We Offer

Complete CCTV Services

From camera selection to live view on your mobile — Zubii Tech handles every step. Just tell us the place; we take care of everything else.

Home CCTV Installation

Complete camera setup for houses — full coverage of your gate, garage, lounge and backyard.

Shop & Office Security

Multi-camera systems for shops, plazas, offices and warehouses, with counter & entry coverage.

HD & IP Cameras

Crystal-clear cameras from 2MP to 8MP — dome, bullet, PTZ and wireless options available.

DVR / NVR Setup

Recording setup with a hard drive — 15 to 30 days of backup, so you never miss any footage.

Mobile App Viewing

Watch your cameras live on mobile from anywhere in the world — app setup and training are completely free.

Night Vision & ColorVu

A clear view even at night — infrared and full-color night vision cameras for round-the-clock protection.

Repair & Maintenance

Old system not working? Camera replacement, wiring repair, DVR upgrades — everything in one place.

24/7 Support

You are never on your own after installation — if anything goes wrong, call or WhatsApp us any time, day or night.
